An [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''swoop rider''' was a member of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Blatant Beks]] during the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]]. He was one of those harassed by a [[Unidentified HoloNet show host|Sullustan fan]].<ref name="Beks Fan" />
